description: NaV₃F₁₀ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fdd2 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.86 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing VF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-34°. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 1.97-1.99 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing VF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-36°. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.02 Å. There are five inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one V atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent V atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to two V atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two V atoms.
